name: Megami Ryoujoku ~Rankou Kariudo Urd~
original_name: 女神凌辱～乱交狩人ウルド～
source:
Urd is a goddess of Valhalla. One day, her country is invaded by monsters and the castle of Valhalla falls to them. Yes, everything is destroyed. She tries to fight back against them, but she is finally captured.... "You know what will happen if a soldier is held hostage...." She is sexually assaulted by monsters, but she says, "I don't hate this kind of pleasure...." "Well, for how much longer are you enduring this assault...?"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090515013037/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012285]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
Urd是Valhalla的女神。一天，国家遭到怪物入侵，Valhalla城堡沦陷，一切都被摧毁。她试图反抗，最终却遭到俘虏…“你知道士兵成为人质后会发生什么…”她遭到怪物性侵，却说：“我并不讨厌这种快感…”“那么，你还能忍受这种侵犯多久…？”
